caption:
UWS Briefly · Oct 15–21

• Three men surrounded a 32-year-old woman in Central Park on Sunday night, hit her in the head and took her bag.
• The sidewalk shed at the Astor, 2139 Broadway, came down. It was up for 12 years.
• Neighbors started a petition against the 13-story condo planned on top of the Gristedes on Columbus.
• The Great Lawn closes for the season two weeks early, for restoration.
• The AI cameras that tracked double-parkers on the UWS for six months came down.
• Nearly 100 LaGuardia students walked out of class and marched to Lincoln Center to protest AI.
• A fire in the shaft between 104 and 106 W. 83rd brought 79 firefighters and EMS workers. Nobody was hurt.
• The mayor says Central Park's horse-drawn carriages are “coming to an end.”

Links to every story are in our bio.
